description: A status effect that applies to an entire team, not just a single jingling. Marks do not disappear when a jingling leaves the field, and newly switched-in jinglings inherit the mark's effect. Each side can only have one positive mark and one negative mark at a time.

zh.name: 印记
zh.description: 常驻在全队的效果，不仅仅作用于单个精灵。精灵下场后印记不会消失，新入场的精灵会继承印记效果。每一方同时只能存在1种正面印记和负面印记。

description: Marks: Speed -10 per stack.
tooltip_description: Marks: Speed -10 per stack.

zh.name: 减速印记
zh.description: 印记效果，速度每层-10。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，速度每层-10。

description: Marks: Recover 1 energy per stack at the end of each turn.
tooltip_description: Marks: Recover 1 energy per stack at the end of each turn.

zh.name: 光合印记
zh.description: 印记效果，回合结束时每层恢复1点能量。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，回合结束时每层恢复1点能量。

description: Marks: All move power +10 per stack.
tooltip_description: Marks: All move power +10 per stack.

zh.name: 攻击印记
zh.description: 印记效果，每层使全技能威力+10。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，每层使全技能威力+10。

description: Marks: On the first turn after entering the battlefield, move power +10.
tooltip_description: Marks: On the first turn after entering the battlefield, move power +10.

zh.name: 蓄电印记
zh.description: 印记效果，入场首回合技能威力+10。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，入场首回合技能威力+10。

description: Marks: All moves' energy cost -1 per stack.
tooltip_description: Marks: All moves' energy cost -1 per stack.

zh.name: 湿润印记
zh.description: 印记效果，每层使全技能能耗-1。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，每层使全技能能耗-1。

description: Marks: When acting first, move power +20%.
tooltip_description: Marks: When acting first, move power +20%.

zh.name: 风起印记
zh.description: 印记效果，先手攻击时，本次技能威力+20%。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，先手攻击时，本次技能威力+20%。

description: Marks: When gaining Buffs, gain 1 additional stack.
tooltip_description: Marks: When gaining Buffs, gain 1 additional stack.

zh.name: 萌芽印记
zh.description: 印记效果，获得增益时，会额外获得1层。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，获得增益时，会额外获得1层。

description: Marks: When a jingling enters the battlefield (in all situations), lose 1 energy per stack.
tooltip_description: Marks: When any jingling enters the battlefield, lose 1 energy per stack.

zh.name: 降灵印记
zh.description: 印记效果，精灵入场时（所有情况），每层失去1能量。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，精灵入场时，每层失去1能量。

description: Marks: After using a 3-energy move, gain Attack +30%.
tooltip_description: Marks: After using a 3-energy move, gain Attack +30%.

zh.name: 龙噬印记
zh.description: 印记效果，释放3能耗技能后，获得双攻+30%。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，释放3能耗技能后，获得双攻+30%。

description: Marks: All Attack-type moves' power +30% and energy cost +1.
tooltip_description: Marks: All Attack-type moves' power +30% and energy cost +1.

zh.name: 蓄势印记
zh.description: 印记效果，全攻击技能威力+30%，且能耗+1。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，全攻击技能威力+30%，且能耗+1。

description: Marks: Deal Poison-type damage equal to 3% (rounded down) of max HP at the end of each turn. The damage amount is affected by type effectiveness.
tooltip_description: Marks: Deal 3% max HP Poison-type damage at the end of each turn. Affected by type effectiveness.

zh.name: 中毒印记
zh.description: 印记效果，回合结束时，造成3%（向下取整）毒属性伤害，受属性克制影响。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，回合结束时造成3%毒属性伤害，受属性克制影响。

description: Marks: After a jingling leaves the battlefield, the newly switched-in jingling loses 6% of max HP.
tooltip_description: Marks: After a jingling leaves the battlefield, the newly switched-in jingling loses 6% of max HP.

zh.name: 棘刺印记
zh.description: 印记效果，场上的精灵离场后，更换入场的精灵失去6%最大生命值。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，场上的精灵离场后，更换入场的精灵失去6%最大生命值。

description: Marks: When attacking a jingling with this mark using a non-Illusion-type move, trigger Starfall Mark, removing all stacks of Starfall Mark and dealing 30 power of magic damage per stack.
tooltip_description: Marks: When attacking a jingling with this mark using a non-Illusion-type move, trigger Starfall Mark, removing all stacks of Starfall Mark and dealing 30 power of magic damage per stack.

zh.name: 星陨印记
zh.description: 印记效果，使用非幻系技能攻击拥有此印记的精灵时，会触发星陨印记，消除全部星陨层数，每层对其造成30威力的魔法伤害。
zh.tooltip_description: 印记效果，使用非幻系技能攻击拥有此印记的精灵时，会触发星陨印记，消除全部星陨层数，每层对其造成30威力的魔法伤害。

description: At the end of each turn, each stack absorbs 6% of max HP from the target. All stacks are removed when the jingling is switched out. (Grass-type jinglings are immune to this effect.)
tooltip_description: Each stack absorbs 6% max HP from the target at the end of each turn. Removed when switched out. (Grass-type immune.)

zh.name: 寄生
zh.description: 回合结束时，每层从寄生来源吸收6%最大生命值，换下场后清除。（草系精灵免疫此效果）
zh.tooltip_description: 回合结束时，每层从寄生来源吸收6%最大生命值，换下场后清除。（草系精灵免疫此效果）

description: At the end of each turn, inflict Poison-type damage equal to 3% (rounded down) of max HP per stack. The damage is affected by type effectiveness. All stacks are removed when the jingling is switched out.
tooltip_description: Deal 3% max HP Poison damage per stack at the end of each turn. Affected by type effectiveness. Removed when switched out.

zh.name: 中毒
zh.description: 回合结束时，每层造成3%（向下取整）毒属性伤害，受到属性克制影响，换下场后清除。
zh.tooltip_description: 回合结束时每层造成3%毒属性伤害，受属性克制影响，换下场后清除。

description: Each stack freezes 5% of max HP, making it unusable. If the remaining HP falls below the frozen amount, the jingling is defeated. This effect persists even after switching out. (Ice-type jinglings are immune to this effect.)
tooltip_description: Each stack freezes 5% of max HP. If HP falls below frozen amount, jingling is defeated. Persists after switching. (Ice-type immune.)

zh.name: 冻结
zh.description: 每层冻结5%最大生命值，冻结部分的生命值不可用，若当前生命低于冻结比例，则力竭，换下场后依然存在。（冰系精灵免疫此效果）
zh.tooltip_description: 每层冻结5%最大生命值，生命低于冻结比例则力竭，换下场后依然存在。（冰系精灵免疫此效果）

description: At the end of each turn, inflict Fire-type damage equal to 2% of max HP per stack, affected by type effectiveness. The number of stacks is halved (rounded up) at the end of each turn, with a minimum reduction of 1 stack. All stacks are removed when the jingling is switched out. (Fire-type jinglings are immune to this effect.)
tooltip_description: Deal 2% max HP Fire-type damage per stack at the end of each turn. Stacks halved each turn. Removed when switched out. (Fire-type immune.)

zh.name: 灼烧
zh.description: 回合结束时，每层造成2%最大生命的火系伤害，并衰减一半（向上取整）层数，最少衰减1层，换下场后清除。（火系精灵免疫此效果）
zh.tooltip_description: 回合结束时，每层造成2%最大生命的火系伤害，层数每回合衰减一半，换下场后清除。（火系精灵免疫此效果）

description: Reverts the jingling to the previous stage of its evolutionary chain, lowering its base stats to that stage while retaining all unlocked traits; if already at the lowest stage, it cannot regress further, and effects that require Regression will not activate at the lowest stage. Regression can stack: each time Regression is applied, it adds 1 stack until reaching the lowest stage. Regression is categorized as a debuff, but some moves may grant additional buffs when Regression is applied. By default, damage resolves first, then Regression is applied.
tooltip_description: Reverts jingling to previous evolution stage, lowering base stats. Stackable. Cannot regress at lowest stage.

zh.name: 萌化
zh.description: 使精灵退回其进化链的上一阶形态，种族值同步降低为上一阶形态，但保留已解锁的特性；若已处于最低形态则无法继续萌化，且需要以萌化为前提才能生效的技能/效果在最低形态下不会触发。萌化可叠加层数；每次获得萌化都会新增1层，叠加至最低形态为止。萌化属于减益系列，但部分技能在获得萌化时会获得额外增益效果。结算顺序默认先结算技能伤害，再使萌化生效。
zh.tooltip_description: 使精灵退回上一进化形态，种族值同步降低，可叠加，最低形态无法继续萌化。

description: When a move with the Devotion effect is used, it grants an enhancement to all 'Bite' and 'Bug Swarm' moves of the user's jinglings. These enhancements can stack, and all active Devotion effects apply at the same time. A random Devotion enhancement includes: move power +20, attacks inflict 2 stacks of Poison, Lifesteal +20%, Combo Count +1, and move energy cost -2.
tooltip_description: When a move with the Devotion effect is used, it grants an enhancement to all 'Bite' and 'Bug Swarm' moves of the user's jinglings. These enhancements can stack, and all active Devotion effects apply at the same time.

zh.name: 奉献
zh.description: 使己方队伍中所有的【啃咬】和【虫群】技能获得奉献对应的强化效果。强化效果可同时存在并叠加。随机一层奉献的强化效果包括：技能威力+20，攻击附加2层中毒，吸血20%，连击数+1，技能能耗-2。
zh.tooltip_description: 使己方队伍中所有的【啃咬】和【虫群】技能获得奉献对应的强化效果。强化效果可同时存在并叠加。

description: Water-type environment. When the weather is Rain, both sides' Water-type move power +50%.
tooltip_description: Water-type weather. When the weather is Rain, both sides' Water-type move power +50%.

zh.name: 雨天
zh.description: 水系环境，天气为雨天时，双方水系技能威力提升50%。
zh.tooltip_description: 水系环境，天气为雨天时，双方水系技能威力提升50%。

description: Ground-type environment. When the weather is Sandstorm, both sides' Ground-type move energy cost is halved.
tooltip_description: Ground-type environment. When the weather is Sandstorm, both sides' Ground-type move energy cost is halved.

zh.name: 沙暴
zh.description: 地系环境，天气为沙暴时，双方地系技能能耗减半。
zh.tooltip_description: 地系环境，天气为沙暴时，双方地系技能能耗减半。

description: Ice-type environment. When the weather is Blizzard, both sides gain 2 stacks of Freeze at the end of each turn. (Ice-type jinglings are immune to this effect.)
tooltip_description: Ice-type environment. When the weather is Blizzard, both sides gain 2 stacks of Freeze at turn end. (Ice-type immune.)

zh.name: 暴风雪
zh.description: 冰系环境，天气为暴风雪时，双方每回合结束时获得2层冻结。（冰系精灵免疫此效果）
zh.tooltip_description: 冰系环境，天气为暴风雪时，双方每回合结束时获得2层冻结。（冰系精灵免疫此效果）

description: Includes both the Poison and Poison Mark effects.
tooltip_description: Includes both the Poison and Poison Mark effects.

zh.name: 中毒效果
zh.description: 包括中毒和中毒印记效果。
zh.tooltip_description: 包括中毒和中毒印记效果。

description: When a move with Inflict Poison X is used, the opponent gains X stacks of Poison.
tooltip_description: When a move with Inflict Poison X is used, the opponent gains X stacks of Poison.

zh.name: 附加中毒
zh.description: 使用附加中毒X的技能会使敌方获得X层中毒。
zh.tooltip_description: 使用附加中毒X的技能会使敌方获得X层中毒。

description: After this move is used, it transforms into a random move from a specified pool, and its energy cost is reduced by 1. After the transformed move is used, it reverts to the original move.
tooltip_description: After this move is used, it transforms into a random move from a specified pool, and its energy cost is reduced by 1. After the transformed move is used, it reverts to the original move.

zh.name: 巧变
zh.description: 使用后会变为指定范围内的随机技能，且能耗-1。使用该随机技能后会变回原技能。
zh.tooltip_description: 使用后会变为指定范围内的随机技能，且能耗-1。使用该随机技能后会变回原技能。

description: When acting for the first time after entering the battlefield, gain an extra effect.
tooltip_description: When acting for the first time after entering the battlefield, gain an extra effect.

zh.name: 迸发
zh.description: 入场后的首次行动，会获得额外效果。
zh.tooltip_description: 入场后的首次行动，会获得额外效果。

description: The jingling's appearance changes to a barrel, temporarily removing its type. When the jingling uses a move, the Barrel status is removed, and the original form is restored.
tooltip_description: The jingling's appearance changes to a barrel, temporarily removing its type. When the jingling uses a move, the Barrel status is removed, and the original form is restored.

zh.name: 木桶状态
zh.description: 精灵的外观变为木桶，在此状态下暂时移除自身系别。当自身释放技能时，木桶状态解除，并恢复原本形态。
zh.tooltip_description: 精灵的外观变为木桶，在此状态下暂时移除自身系别。当自身释放技能时，木桶状态解除，并恢复原本形态。

description: The jingling cannot act under this effect.
tooltip_description: The jingling cannot act under this effect.

zh.name: 眩晕
zh.description: 精灵在此效果下无法行动。
zh.tooltip_description: 精灵在此效果下无法行动。

description: This turn, the jingling charges up and spends energy, becoming immune to all Leave Field effects. Next turn, user can only use the charged move, use Focus, or switch out. If Focus is used during the charging turn, the charge status remains.
tooltip_description: Charges up this turn spending energy, immune to Leave Field effects. Next turn: can only use the charged move, Focus, or switch out.

zh.name: 蓄力
zh.description: 本回合进行蓄力并扣除能量，期间免疫所有离场效果。下回合只可释放已蓄力技能、聚能或下场。如蓄力时释放聚能，蓄力状态依旧存在。
zh.tooltip_description: 本回合蓄力并扣除能量，免疫离场效果。下回合只可释放蓄力技能、聚能或下场。

description: Allows the jingling to continue Charge for one more turn. The charged move can be used one additional time.
tooltip_description: Continue Charge for one more turn. The charged move can be used one additional time.

zh.name: 积蓄
zh.description: 可继续蓄力一回合，最终技能可额外释放次数+1。
zh.tooltip_description: 可继续蓄力一回合，最终技能可额外释放次数+1。

description: When a jingling is actively switched in (not as a result of another jingling's defeat), it immediately uses the first available move with this effect and sufficient energy. The turn order for this move is determined by the Speed of the two jinglings on the battlefield. However, if this move's Counter effect triggers, it is resolved using Counter's priority rules instead.
tooltip_description: When a jingling is actively switched in (not as a result of another jingling's defeat), it immediately uses the first available move with this effect and sufficient energy.

zh.name: 迅捷
zh.description: 通过主动更换精灵的方式入场时（非因其他精灵力竭而入场），立即使用第一个能量满足要求，并带有迅捷的技能。一般情况下，此技能的先手顺序由在场双方精灵的速度决定；如果本技能触发了【应对】效果，则改按【应对】的结算顺序处理。
zh.tooltip_description: 通过主动更换精灵的方式入场时（非因其他精灵力竭而入场），立即使用第一个能量满足要求，并带有迅捷的技能。

description: The selected move is performed twice, consuming 1 stack of Overload.
tooltip_description: The selected move is performed twice, consuming 1 stack of Overload.

zh.name: 过载
zh.description: 所选技能释放两次，消耗一层过载。
zh.tooltip_description: 所选技能释放两次，消耗一层过载。

description: At the start of the turn, moves with 'Transmission X' will move down X Slot, and this effect can stack.
tooltip_description: At the start of the turn, moves with 'Transmission X' will move down X Slot, and this effect can stack.

zh.name: 传动
zh.description: 回合开始时，带有"传动X"的技能会向下移动X个位置，该效果可叠加。
zh.tooltip_description: 回合开始时，带有"传动X"的技能会向下移动X个位置，该效果可叠加。

description: Interrupts the opponent's move this turn. Opponent's move is not executed and the interrupted move's energy cost is refunded to the opponent.
tooltip_description: Interrupts the opponent's move this turn. Move is not executed and energy is refunded.

zh.name: 打断
zh.description: 打断敌人本回合释放的技能。敌方技能不执行，并返还被打断技能的能量。
zh.tooltip_description: 打断敌人本回合释放的技能。敌方技能不执行，并返还被打断技能的能量。

description: When dealing damage, recover HP equal to a percentage of the damage dealt. When used as a single-use move effect, it applies lifesteal based on the damage dealt by that move. When used as Buffs, it triggers lifesteal on every attack while the buff is active.
tooltip_description: When dealing damage, recover HP equal to a percentage of the damage dealt.

zh.name: 吸血
zh.description: 造成伤害时，按比例回复自身的生命。当作为单次技能效果时，按比例吸血；当作为增益效果时，每次攻击都触发吸血。
zh.tooltip_description: 造成伤害时，按比例回复自身生命值。

description: The jingling is defeated and cannot be used.

zh.name: 力竭
zh.description: 精灵被打败，无法入场使用。

description: Each player has 4 Life Points at the start of the battle. Generally, when a jingling is defeated, the player loses 1 Life Point. Some traits can have different effects on Life Points. If a player runs out of Life Points, they lose the battle.

zh.name: 魔力值
zh.description: 每位玩家在战斗开始时拥有4点魔力值。一般情况下，当一只精灵力竭时，玩家会失去1点魔力值。有些特性会对魔力值有不同的影响。如果玩家的魔力值耗尽，则输掉战斗。

description: Modifiers to Move Power apply to the base power of all moves the jingling currently has. Modifiers can stack, with each stack increasing or decreasing the total effect. All modifications are removed when the jingling leaves the battlefield.
tooltip_description: Modifiers to base power of all current moves. Stackable. Removed when jingling leaves battlefield.

zh.name: 全技能威力
zh.description: 对全技能威力的增减会影响该精灵当前所有技能的基础威力，且可叠加。精灵离开场地时，所有调整效果移除。
zh.tooltip_description: 增减精灵当前所有技能的基础威力，可叠加，离场后清除。

description: Modifiers to Move Energy Cost apply to the amount of energy required to use each move the jingling currently has. Modifiers can stack, with each stack increasing or decreasing the total effect. All modifications are removed when the jingling leaves the battlefield.
tooltip_description: Modifiers to energy cost of all current moves. Stackable. Removed when jingling leaves battlefield.

zh.name: 全技能能耗
zh.description: 对全技能能耗的增减会影响该精灵当前所有技能释放所需的能量，且可叠加。精灵离开场地时，所有调整效果移除。
zh.tooltip_description: 增减精灵当前所有技能的能耗，可叠加，离场后清除。

description: Moves whose type matches at least one of the jingling's own types. For example, if a jingling is Water/Grass, then both Water-type and Grass-type moves are considered same-type moves.
tooltip_description: Moves whose type matches at least one of the jingling's own types.

zh.name: 本系技能
zh.description: 指与精灵自身任一系别相同的技能。例如：若精灵为水系/草系，则水系技能和草系技能都视为本系技能。
zh.tooltip_description: 与精灵自身任一系别相同的技能。

description: The number of turns that must pass before a move or magic item can be used again. Unless otherwise specified, all Defense-type moves have a 1-turn cooldown, while moves of other categories have no cooldown. For magic items, Willpower Enhancement has a 3-turn cooldown, while other magic item effects are single-use per battle.

zh.name: 冷却
zh.description: 技能或血脉魔法在再次使用前必须经过的回合数。除非另有说明，所有防御类技能的冷却为1回合，而其他类别的技能通常没有冷却；血脉魔法中【愿力强化】的冷却为3回合，而其他血脉魔法为每场一次性使用。

description: The number of consecutive attacks performed by a move with the Combo effect.
tooltip_description: The number of consecutive attacks performed by a move with the Combo effect.

zh.name: 连击数
zh.description: 改变连击次数，仅对有连击的技能生效。
zh.tooltip_description: 改变连击次数，仅对有连击的技能生效。

description: Perform x consecutive attacks, where x is the Combo Count. Each hit uses the move's base power.

zh.name: 连击
zh.description: 进行x次连续攻击，x为连击数，每次攻击使用技能的基础威力。

description: The order in which moves are executed. Moves with higher priority ignore speed differences between the two jinglings and are executed first. If priority values are the same, the jingling with higher speed acts first.
